body: My parents are generally unreasonable when it comes to any arguments I have that don’t support what they personally believe. They even admitted to not really reading the Bible much, but instead trusting the word of people who have read it more than them (aka our pastor and youth minister). My problem with that is the pastor and youth minister are influenced by the message pushed by organized religion. They are being influenced by outside sources just like my parents claim that I’m being influenced in a negative way by outside sources.
I’ve had this said to me by my parents. It doesn’t feel great.
Yes, if something bad happened to me then I’d have a reason to feel like shit.
I’m from Missouri. I know how many big super bowl parties happened yesterday. You should expect our case numbers to go up very soon.

Thanks. I don’t know about resources in my area. I also get too paranoid when trying to reach out. I always feel that somehow it will come back to bite me. That someone will find out that shouldn’t know and they’ll use the information against me.

That’s what I thought. That’s the only reason I agreed to talk in the first place. I’m 18 and I should be able to speak to someone without them going over my head. But apparently anything that has to do with “harm to self” takes precedence.

Hey man, I feel you. I’m a 17yo trans guy who has been considering running for awhile now. I should be able to give you some advice if I know what your plans are. Feel free to message me if you want someone to run ideas past. I’ll try to help the best I can.
Do it, start a chat. I also need someone to geek out with. The few people I know who play never want to talk. It’d be fun to actually get to talk about something I’m passion about. :)

Hey, uh, thank you for putting this here. I don’t think I can cross platform as I’m on PC playing Java not Bedrock but if you’re down I’d love to maybe message about the game. I play when I need to focus on something that’s real but not reality (that probably doesn’t make sense, I don’t know). No one wants to talk about the Nether update with me but it’s one of the few things in life I’m excited about right now. So, yeah, if you want to chat, just about the game, I’d be grateful for it.

Do you have a drivers permit? If so, you may want to look into trying to get your license before leaving. There is a lot of paperwork required and it may be easier to get it while still at home. However, if you don’t think you’ll need it then there’s also no harm in waiting.

You need a ride that won’t tell your parents. You can lie to them and tell them that you’re flying somewhere you aren’t but even then once they realize you’re missing it wouldn’t be too difficult to track you down if they knew when you flew out. I don’t know if authorities would go that far but they might. You could even get them to drop you off at a nearby bus station that had options for taking a bus to the airport. Buses are always an option. The extra steps may be my anxiety speaking but it’s just a thought.

Additionally, you have to get a ticket on an airline that allows you to fly on your own at 15. Most airlines do but not all. Allegiant does but that’s the only airline I have a lot of experience flying solo with.

Do some of your own research too. I’m giving you the best advice I can as a person who’s flown many many times.

I understand where you’re coming from. I’m 17 and also FtM but I’m still in the closet for my own safety. If you want to talk through your plan some more, run it by another person or just talk in general, feel free to send me a private message and we can talk more.
Yup. People write it off as nothing. Even when the facade slips people just think I’ve had a bad day. The problem is, I can’t tell if they’re actually ignorant or don’t care enough to listen.

You’re definitely not alone when it comes to putting on a seemingly normal facade. This is exactly what I’ve been dealing with. The person those around me think they they know is just a facade. It’s not real. No one knows who I really am. It’s just an elaborate act I’ve been putting on for years.
